answer.reason: The "features grid" on the site is rendered by the Bento Section component ("Shows a subheading, heading, and a list of 'Bento' cards. A great way to showcase some screenshots or graphics."). Its grid items are stored as content items in the BentoCard content model (container home_BentoSection_BentoCard), which has Eyebrow, Title, Description, and an ImageAttachment field called "Graphic" — exactly suited for a card with a screenshot. A new card for the features grid should be created as a new BentoCard content item.
